shots.speaker: KESTREL
shots.line: Control said the relay tower went dark at midnight. Somebody forgot to tell the beacon.
shots.camera: Wide rooftop 3/4 profile in neon rain; Kestrel holds glowing brass astrolabe toward blinking harbor beacon.

shots.speaker: DISPATCH_RADIO
shots.line: Kestrel, drop the brass compass and clear the roof. That signal isn't ours.
shots.camera: Macro OTS insert on gloved hand, #DC8229 amber jacket cuff, and brass astrolabe needle spinning wildly under rain.

shots.speaker: KESTREL
shots.line: Too late. The needle already locked onto the harbor.
shots.camera: Medium close-up reaction over shoulder under cyan/magenta neon rain reflection; asymmetric silver-white hair with dark teal streak.

shots.speaker: KESTREL
shots.line: Keep the line open. I'm going down to read it myself.
shots.camera: Low-angle dynamic action frame at rooftop ledge stepping into harbor searchlight mist.
